svg.title: Static ordering is different from constant attention values
svg.desc: Two shared keys -1,+1 and query offsets -2,+2. Conditional softmax over these TWO keys only. Full GAT rows also contain self; adding candidates does not reverse pair ordering.

g.text: One additive GAT head: shared-key ranking stays fixed
Conditional weights over the common two keys ONLY (self omitted here)
Both prefer key +1; preference strength changes across the LeakyReLU branches.
Bar length: conditional attention probability, dimensionless; this is not a whole-network impossibility claim.
